kvkk.title: Privacy and Personal Data Protection (KVKK) Notice

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
body: This site is an independent news synthesis platform published at bu site. Contact: iletisim@example.com.

sections.heading: 2. No Personal Data Is Processed
body: There is no account creation, sign-in, membership, password, newsletter subscription or form-based data collection. We do not ask for name, e-mail, phone, address, date of birth or location.
No cookies are used — not even strictly necessary ones. There are no third-party analytics, ad networks, pixels, heatmaps or A/B testing tools.
Visitor IP addresses are not read, stored or used for profiling by the application. No IP-based geolocation is performed.

sections.heading: 3. Preferences Stored Only on Your Device
body: Theme, font size, line height, simple reading mode, bookmarks, read marks, playback position and an optional city choice are kept only in your browser's localStorage.
This data is never sent to the server, shared with third parties or leaves your device. It is kept until you delete it — via browser settings or the 'Clear all' action on the Bookmarks page.
The localStorage schema is versioned (storageVersion: 1) and ready for future migrations.

sections.heading: 4. No International Transfers
body: Since no personal data is processed, there is no international transfer.
News synthesis and AI summaries run server-side and do not use visitor personal data. AI assistant chats are not stored on the server; they are processed only for the duration of that request.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Links and Embeds
body: The site links to news sources and YouTube videos. Embeds are click-to-load: no request reaches a third party before you click, and a notice is shown beforehand.
Once you click, the third party's own privacy policy applies.

sections.heading: 6. Server-Side Technical Logs
body: No visitor-level logging or profiling is performed at the application level.
Standard technical logs kept by the hosting provider for security and operations are subject to their own policies and are not used by us for marketing or profiling.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights Under Article 11 of KVKK
body: You have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, request information, learn the purpose, request correction or deletion, and claim compensation for unlawful processing.
Since no personal data is processed, there is no data subject to these requests. You may still contact iletisim@example.com; requests are answered within 30 days.

sections.heading: 1. Nature of the Service
body: Stories published on this site are AI-synthesized summaries of events verified across at least three independent sources. Content is provided for information only and does not constitute legal, financial or medical advice.

sections.heading: 2. Rules of Use
body: Using the site for unlawful purposes, stressing the service with automated scraping, or compromising its security is prohibited.
Synthesized content may not be reproduced commercially without attribution.

sections.heading: 3. Limitation of Liability
body: Despite the verification process, synthesized content may contain errors. For critical information you are encouraged to check the primary sources directly. Questions: iletisim@example.com.

sections.heading: 1. Content and Attribution Policy
body: Stories are original syntheses based on the factual event reported in public RSS feeds. Source article text is not copied.
Each story lists source names, source links and retrieval times. Linking to sources does not remove copyright; rights remain with their owners.

sections.heading: 2. Takedown Requests
body: If you believe content infringes your copyright, e-mail iletisim@example.com with: (a) the exact URL on this site, (b) proof of ownership, (c) your contact details.
There is NO takedown FORM on the site; to avoid collecting personal data, only e-mail is used.
Requests are reviewed within 72 hours; valid requests result in removal.

sections.heading: 3. AI-Generated Content
body: Synthesized text is generated by AI and may contain errors. It is not binding and does not constitute legal, financial or medical advice.

sections.heading: About the Platform
body: bu site is an independent news synthesis platform that continuously monitors domestic and international news sources. Our goal is to consolidate scattered information about the same event into a single, clear and original report.
The platform offers up-to-date news feeds, audio summaries and AI-assisted podcast episodes across categories including world news, technology, science, sports and economy.

sections.heading: How It Works
body: Our system scans nearly 30 domestic and international news sources within minutes. Sources covering the same event are automatically merged; the story is rewritten in an original and neutral tone with AI assistance.
Every published story passes a separate AI-supported quality review both before and after publication. Content found inadequate or inaccurate is removed from the feed.

sections.heading: Our Editorial Principles
body: Originality: No story is copied from any source; all content is synthesized in our own words.
Neutrality: Stories only convey commonly verified information, without taking sides.
Copyright care: The copyrights of source publishers are respected; takedown requests can be sent via our contact address.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For feedback, corrections and content removal requests: iletisim@example.com

sections.heading: 1. We Use No Cookies
body: This site uses no cookies at all: no strictly necessary, preference, analytics, advertising or third-party cookies.
If you open DevTools → Application → Cookies, the list stays empty.

sections.heading: 2. Device-Stored Preferences (localStorage)
body: eth.v1.prefs — theme, font size, line height, simple reading mode, read marks and optional city.
eth.v1.bookmarks — saved stories (id, title, URL, category, saved date).
eth.v1.read — ids of stories marked as read.
eth.v1.playback — the episode and second you stopped at.
eth.v1.searches — recent search terms kept on this device only.

sections.heading: 3. How to Delete
body: Clear site data from your browser settings. The Bookmarks page also offers 'Clear all'.
In a private window, this data is removed automatically when the window closes.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics and Measurement
body: No Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar or similar measurement tool is used.
If cookie-free, aggregate-only measurement is adopted in the future, this page and the interface will be updated explicitly.
